elements_selected.content: TOFU collision disambiguation UI per REQ-3425. When shim detects invite URL + existing IDB binding, renders the wireframe from REQ-3425 with three options: KEEP (default), Add alongside, Replace (requires 1-line rationale stored in local audit log). Focus on KEEP by default. No silent overwrites.
